qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant European artillery munitions and combat vehicle manufacturer. Command of certified 155mm production lines, propellants (Nitrochemie), and Leopard/Boxer components provides formidable pricing power backed by a €60B+ order backlog.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (6=N, REJECT). Europe's land defense champion with dominant artillery munitions share, but multi-year FCF conversion falls short of the 80% threshold (~70% multi-year) due to heavy working capital expansion, long-cycle project inventories, and major factory capex.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year FCF conversion 2018-2023 averaged ~69.5% of net income (below the 80% hurdle), impacted by substantial inventory builds and capex for ammunition manufacturing capacity. Net debt reached €1.24B in 2024. High defense backlog (€60B+) requires continuous heavy capital absorption.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
